title: 04_severe_mechanism_co_svr
interpretation: The two drive MAP down to ≈70 mmHg (still above the MAP<65 shock threshold at 48 h) by different routes: the engine declines via cardiac-output failure with near-constant SVR (hypodynamic/low-output), while the extraction holds output and swings SVR — vasoconstriction then sympathetic-fatigue vasodilation (hyperdynamic/warm). The extraction's single AIR→sympathetic arc overshoots the vasomotor response the engine's full cardiovascular control keeps muted.
